gloss: a lifesaver in a desperate situation; salvation in dire straits

definitions.gloss: a lifesaver when things look hopeless; salvation in dire straits
definitions.explanation: Literally "a Buddha in hell." Describes help, or a helper, appearing when one is in serious trouble with no way out. Stronger than an ordinary lucky break: the situation must be genuinely desperate.

examples.japanese: ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}だった。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っていたら→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦もらい→もらう：00520_morau⟧、{地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧だった。
examples.english: I was lost when someone spoke to me — it felt like salvation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくして⟦{困|こま}り→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{果|は}てていた→果てる：28565_hateru⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れ→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧ようだった。
examples.english: I had lost my wallet and was at my wits' end when a friend turned up — like meeting a Buddha in hell.

notes:
USAGE:
Most often predicative ({地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}だ / だった) or attributive ({地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧). The fuller form ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧よう is equally common, and the particle varies freely between ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ and ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}: a lifesaver indeed
- {地獄|じごく}に{仏|ほとけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧: the feeling of being rescued
- ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧よう: like meeting a Buddha in hell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{渡|わた}りに{船|ふね}→渡りに船：30608_watarinifune⟧: a godsend — well-timed help, but the situation need not be desperate
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ぼたもち: a windfall — unexpected good luck, not rescue
